arxiv-2306-10868.creator: Keir L. Birchall, M. G. Watson, J. Aird, R. L. C. Starling
arxiv-2306-10868.description: Abstract We present the identification and analysis of an X-ray selected AGN sample that lie within the local ( z < 0.35 z<0.35 ) galaxy population. From a parent sample of 22,079 MPA-JHU (based on SDSS DR8) galaxies, we identified 917 galaxies with central, excess X-ray emission (from 3XMM-DR7) likely originating from an AGN.

arxiv-2506-00557.title: Score Matching with Missing Data
arxiv-2506-00557.creator: Josh Givens, Song Liu, Henry W J Reeve
arxiv-2506-00557.description: Abstract Score matching is a vital tool for learning the distribution of data with applications across many areas including diffusion processes, energy based modelling, and graphical model estimation. Despite all these applications, little work explores its use when data is incomplete.

arxiv-2509-26446.title: Is the Peculiar Galactic Center Transient Swift J174610.4-290018 A Recurrent Nova? Facilities: Swift /XRT, Chandra , NuSTAR
arxiv-2509-26446.creator: Ziqian Hua, Zhiyuan Li
arxiv-2509-26446.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ziqian Hua, Zhiyuan Li. Swift J174610.4–290018, a peculiar transient X-ray source originally discovered by the Swift satellite in February 2024 at the onset of its outburst, recently attracted intentional or coincident follow-up X-ray observations using Swift , NuSTAR and Chandra . We have performed a comprehensive analysis of the relevant X-ray data to investigate the spectral and temporal properties of this source between October 2000 and July 2024.

arxiv-2512-17055.title: Packet Detection in a Filter Bank-Based Ultra-Wideband Communication System
arxiv-2512-17055.creator: Brian Nelson, Member, IEEE, Behrouz Farhang-Boroujeny, Life Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2512-17055.description: Abstract Recently, filter bank multi-carrier spread spectrum (FBMC-SS) technology has been proposed for use in ultra-wideband (UWB) communication systems. It has been noted that, due to the spectral partitioning properties of the filter banks, a UWB signal can be synthesized and processed using a parallel set of signal processors operating at a moderate rate.

pmc-11355220.title: Outcomes of I-125 Low-Dose-Rate Brachytherapy in Patients with Localized Prostate Cancer: A Comprehensive Analysis from a Specialized Tertiary Referral Center
pmc-11355220.creator: Philipp Schubert, Vratislav Strnad, Daniel Höfler, Claudia Schweizer, Florian Putz, Michael Lotter, Stephan Kreppner, Andre Karius, Rainer Fietkau, Ricarda Merten, Liang Cheng
pmc-11355220.description: Low-dose-rate (LDR) brachytherapy with I-125 seeds is one of the most common primary tumor treatments for low-risk and low-intermediate-risk prostate cancer. This report aimed to present an analysis of single-institution long-term results. We analyzed the treatment outcomes of 119 patients with low- and intermediate-risk prostate cancer treated with LDR brachytherapy at our institution between 2014 and 2020.

pmc-11423145.title: Cooperative binding of bivalent ligands yields new insights into the guanidine-II riboswitch
pmc-11423145.creator: Jakob Steuer, Malte Sinn, Franziska Eble, Sina Rütschlin, Thomas Böttcher, Jörg S Hartig, Christine Peter
pmc-11423145.description: Riboswitches are involved in regulating the gene expression in bacteria. They are located within the untranslated regions of bacterial messenger RNA and function as switches by adjusting their shape, depending on the presence or absence of specific ligands. To decipher the fundamental aspects of bacterial gene control, it is therefore important to understand the mechanisms that underlie these conformational switches.

pmc-11550364.title: mRNA vaccine-induced IgG mediates nasal SARS-CoV-2 clearance in mice
pmc-11550364.creator: Charlie Fricke, Lorenz Ulrich, Jana Kochmann, Janina Gergen, Kristina Kovacikova, Nicole Roth, Julius Beer, Daniel Schnepf, Thomas C Mettenleiter, Susanne Rauch, Benjamin Petsch, Donata Hoffmann, Martin Beer, Björn Corleis, Anca Dorhoi
pmc-11550364.description: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) mRNA vaccines that have contributed to controlling the SARS-CoV-2 pandemic induce specific serum antibodies, which correlate with protection. However, the neutralizing capacity of antibodies for emerging SARS-CoV-2 variants is altered. Suboptimal antibody responses are observed in patients with humoral immunodeficiency diseases, ongoing B cell depletion therapy, and aging.

pmc-12645742.title: AI-ding peer feedback: a randomized study of self-generated vs. ai-assisted peer feedback
pmc-12645742.creator: Zachary R Noel, Heewoo Lee, Christina H Sherrill, Ian B Hollis, Jacqueline E McLaughlin
pmc-12645742.description: PurposeProviding effective peer feedback plays an important role in collaborative learning and is an essential professional skill for students to develop. This study investigates whether generative AI can improve the quality of peer feedback, and whether it influences students’ perceptions of the feedback received.MethodsAn experimental design was employed involving 129 third-year Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) students.

pmc-13116632.title: The Need for Standardized Data Collection to Improve Harmonization and Pooling of Information About Modifiable Risk Factors for Alzheimer’s Diseases in Italian Clinical Studies: A Systematic Review
pmc-13116632.creator: Patrizio Allegra, Manuela Lodico, Claudia Migliazzo, Domenico Tarantino, Tommaso Piccoli, Nicola Vanacore, Giuseppe Salemi, Laura Maniscalco, Domenica Matranga
pmc-13116632.description: Background/Objectives: At the international level, harmonized networks of dementia clinical studies are available, but Italian participation remains limited. This systematic review aims to define harmonization rules to facilitate the inclusion of Italian clinical studies in existing networks and to propose standardized data collection methods to enable comparison of the study results.

pmc-13261907.title: A pan-cancer atlas of metabolic regulatory circuitries integrating multi-omic, immune, and clinical dimensions
pmc-13261907.creator: Higor Almeida Cordeiro Nogueira, Emanuell Rodrigues de Souza, Victor dos Santos Lopes, Enrique Medina-Acosta
pmc-13261907.description: IntroductionMetabolic reprogramming is a central determinant of tumor progression, immune evasion, and susceptibility to regulated cell death. However, the integration of metabolic regulation across genomic, multi-omic, immune, and clinical dimensions remains insufficiently resolved, limiting mechanistic interpretation and translational application in cancer.

pmc-13298914.title: Dual Amino Acid Swap in MUC7-Derived Peptide Enhances Resistance and Modulates Zn(II) and Cu(II) Complex Stability, Secondary Structure and Antimicrobial Activity
pmc-13298914.creator: Klaudia Szarszoń, Jan Kachnowicz, Tomasz Janek, Alicia Domínguez-Martin, Aneta Jezierska, Joanna Wątły
pmc-13298914.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Metal ion complexes with antimicrobial peptides are emerging as promising therapeutic agents, but their efficacy is often limited by rapid proteolytic degradation and poorly understood metal-driven mechanisms. Here, we stabilize a sequence derived from mucin 7 by introducing two d-amino acids at the site most susceptible to proteolytic cleavage and show that this subtle modification rewires its copper­(II) and zinc­(II) coordination chemistry and antimicrobial activity.

pmc-13557947.title: Association of dietary practice, rather than knowledge or attitude, with health-related quality of life in elderly NMIBC survivors: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13557947.creator: Xiaodong Qing, Jiawen Huang, Wenbo Gao
pmc-13557947.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHealth-related quality of life (HRQoL) is a critical concern in elderly non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) survivors, but modifiable dietary factors remain underexplored. Using a cross sectional design, this study aimed to investigate the association between dietary knowledge-attitude-practice (KAP) scores and HRQoL in recurrence-free elderly NMIBC patients 12 months after TURBT, and to identify which KAP dimension shows the strongest independent association.MethodsWe enrolled 106 patients (aged ≥60 years) recurrence-free at 12 months post-TURBT who completed intravesical therapy.

pmc-13571684.title: Association of ABO Blood Groups with HPV Genotypes and Cervical Lesions in HPV-Positive Women
pmc-13571684.creator: Ramazan Adan, Hicran Acar Şirinoğlu, Alpaslan Kaban, Deniz Taşdemir, Muhammet Yılmaz, Fatih Şahin, Alp Koray Kinter
pmc-13571684.description: AimThis study aimed to investigate the distribution of ABO and Rh blood groups among HPV-positive women and to evaluate their associations with HPV genotype, cervical cytology, and colposcopic findings.Materials and MethodsThis retrospective observational study included 128 HPV-positive women who underwent cervical cytology and colposcopic evaluation.

pmc-13663259.title: A comparative approach to analyzing and forecasting carbon dioxide emissions in ethiopia using Bayesian autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA) and Bayesian structural time series (BSTS) models
pmc-13663259.creator: Abdisalan Ahmed Osman, Dagne Tesfaye Mengistie, Daud Hussein Adawe, Rediat Takele Figa, Buzuneh Tasfa Marine
pmc-13663259.description: IntroductionCarbon dioxide (CO₂) emissions are a major contributor to global climate change. In Ethiopia, CO₂ emissions have increased steadily in recent decades due to industrialization, rising energy consumption, expanding transportation systems, continued dependence on biomass fuels, and rapid population growth.
